newsitem.title: USA: MCI to test wireless Internet delivery.
newsitem.headline: MCI to test wireless Internet delivery.

text.p: American Telecasting Inc said Tuesday it had tenatively agreed to a deal with MCI Communications Corp to test high-speed Internet services using American Telecasting's wireless cable service.
The company said the test, which is subject to definitive agreement, will include locations agreed to by both American Telecasting and MCI.
The initial test in expected in the fourth quarter of 1996, Telecasting said.

"Earlier this year we established to our satisfaction that MMDS spectrum can be used to deliver high speed Internet access using off-the-shelf products," said Robert Hostetler, president and chief executive of Telecasting.

MMDS spectrum refers to the radio spectrum which telecasting is licensed to use in 39 U.S. regional markets to offer its wireless cable services. Telecasting serves about 178,000 subscribers currently.
